title: A year of fighting scrapers on my 1.5 million-page website
summary: The article details a year-long battle against scrapers and bots on a 1.5 million-page website, where 99% of traffic is automated. It covers detection methods, mitigation strategies (e.g., rate limiting, CAPTCHAs, IP blocking), and the cat-and-mouse game with evolving bot behavior, offering practical lessons for site operators.
